verbetes.glosa_atual: Z’no ḥ a (b. h. זָנוֹחַ, Josh. XV, 34; 56) na Judéia.
definicoes_originais: Z’no ḥ a (b. h. זָנוֹחַ, Josh. XV, 34; 56) in Judaea.
notas_originais: Men. VIII, 1 (83 b) Ar. a. Rashi (ed. זטחא, Ms. M. זונחא, Mish. ed. מזוניחה, Mish. Nap. וזוניחא; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); Tosef. ib. IX, 2 זו לחה (corr. acc.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: prostituição; בני ז' filhos gerados na prostituição.; sensualidade.
definicoes_originais: prostitution; בני ז' children begotten in prostitution.
notas_originais: Pes. 87 a bot. בני ז'; ib. b ובניך בני ז' Ms. M. (ed. בנים ז', ובניך ז', v. זָנַן).
Ib. 111 a אחדא … רוח ז' sexual passion will seize him (her).
, v. זִינּוּק

Sot. IX, 15 (49 b) בית הועד יהיה לז' (= לבית ז') the scholars’ meeting house shall become a place of licentiousness (where low people assemble). Num. R. s. 13 על ז' אחותו for seducing his sister. Ab. Zar. 36 b דרך ז' a meretricious connection, opp. אִישׁוּת. Gen. R. s. 26 על הכל … חוץ מן הז' … the Lord is long-suffering to everything except debauchery. Keth. 3 a, v. בְּעִילָה; a. v. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Targ. Y. Gen. XXXIII, 2. Targ. Hos. IV, 11; um. frag.—Targ. Jó XXXVI, 14 מרי ז' donos de bordéis. 3 b ז' בביתא וכ' a infidelidade na casa é como um verme nas papoulas.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Gen. XXXIII, 2. Targ. Hos. IV, 11; a. fr.—Targ. Job XXXVI, 14 מרי ז' keepers of brothels.—Sot. 3 b ז' בביתא וכ' faithlessness in the house is like a worm in poppy-plants.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.) brilhar (cmp. דנח) ser gordo; ser gorduroso, sujo (cmp. significados de זהם, צחן, v. Ges. Tes. s. v. זנח);; (ato. verbo) detestar.; ser relutante.; declarar rejeitável, impuro; (cmp. זהם) rejeitar; (cmp. סאב, רחק) para remover.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) to glisten (cmp. דנח) to be fat; to be greasy, foul (cmp. meanings of זהם, צחן, v. Ges. Thes. s. v. זנח);
to declare rejectable, unclean; (cmp. זהם) to reject; (cmp. סאב, רחק) to remove.
to make glistening, to stroke, dress.
notas_originais: Midr. Till. to Ps. LX; Yalk. Ps. 777 אני זָנַחְתִּי אתכם אתם זְנַחְתֶּם אותי did I loathe you? You loathed me.
Pesik. R. s. 41 (ref. to זונה, Ps. LXXIII, 27) שרחקו וזָנְחוּ הימך because they removed themselves from and were loth of Thee.
Ḥull. 7 a אין מַזְנִיחִין אותו we must not detest him (remove him from college). Pesik. R. l. c. מַזְנִיחִים עצמם הימך they (through their sins) remove themselves from thee.
Lev. R. s. l, beg. (ref. to אבי זנוח) I Chr. IV, 18) that is Moses שהיה אב למַזְנִיחִים שהִזְנִיחָם מע"ז for he was the father of the cleaners, for he cleansed them from idolatry; Yalk. ib. 428.

Num. R. s. 20; Tanḥ. Balak 12 באתי … זִנַּחְתִּיהָ I had come to kill her, and now I had to polish her up; (Tanḥ. ed. Bub. ib. 20 זיניתה; Yalk. Num. 768, Matt. K. to Num. R. l. c. quotes in Tanḥ. l. c. דכיתיה).

verbetes.glosa_atual: , Targ. Sal. XV, 5 ed. Lag., leia יזוּחַ ou יזוּעַ.
notas_originais: , Targ. Ps. XV, 5 יזנח ed. Lag., read יזוּחַ or יזוּעַ.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (b. h.); [correr de um lado para outro, vagar;] (com אחר) correr atrás, (com מאחרי) fugir; especialmente. correr como uma prostituta, ser infiel, ser impuro (cmp. cap. נפקת ברא para זוֹנָה, a. טעי para nosso w.).; cometer uma ofensa.; mesmo, também para convidar à falta de fé, para excitar os sentidos.
definicoes_originais: [ to run to and fro, wander;] (with אחר) to run after, (with מאחרי) to run away from; esp. to run about as a prostitute, to be faithless, be unchaste (cmp. ch. נפקת ברא for זוֹנָה, a. טעי for our w.).
same, also to invite faithlessness, to excite the senses.
notas_originais: Sabb. 55 b (play on פ̇ח̇ז̇, Gen. XLIX, 4) פ̇סעת … ח̇טאת זָ֗נִיתָ thou hast trespassed upon religion, sinned, been unchaste (v. זוּל).—Snh. 100 b שמא תִזְנֶה lest she may go astray (be seduced); a. v. fr.
Gitt. 6 b explain. ותזנה עליו, Jud. XIX, 2, cmp. Targ. a. l.

Sabb. 88 b עלובה כלה מְזַנָּה בתוך חופתה (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) bold is the bride who thinks of faithlessness while getting married; Gitt. 36 b שזִינְּתָה בקרב וכ'. Sot. 10 a כל המְזַנֶּה … מְזַנֶּנֶת עליו if a man is lewd, his wife will think of faithlessness against him; Yalk. Job 918 מְזַנָּה תחתיו. Meg. 15 a רחב בשמה זִינְּתָה וכ' Raḥab suggested impure thoughts by her name ( Ra ḥ ab hazzonah), Jael with her call (Jud. IV, 18) &c., v. זְכִירָה; a. fr.—Trnsf. (of plants) to degenerate. Gen. R. s. 28, end אף הארץ זינתה the earth, too, became degenerated in her produces; v. זוֹנַיָּיא. Y. Kil. I, beg. 26 d הפירות מְזַנִּין the produces may degenerate (ref. to Lev. XIX, 29).
same. Targ. Y. Gen. XXXVIII, 24 זַנְיַית (O. זַנִּיאַת); a. e.

Targ. O. Deut. XXII, 21 לזַנָּ' ed. Berl. (ed. Amst. לזְנָאָה); a. e.—Keth. 81 a ספק זַנָּאִי וכ' there is a doubt, did she or did she not commit adultery?—*Denom. אַיְיזַן f. a runner ( after men). Snh. 106 a bot. (prov.) מסגני ושילטי הואי א' לגברי נגרי (נגדי) after (living with) princes and governors she became a runner after ship draggers (or carpenters). [Our w. is absent in Yalk. Num. 785 as well as in Ms. M., the latter having a marginal version אזלא הויא.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: , Sra. Prov. XXIX, 3, leia-se: זַנְיָיתָא, זְנָיָי', v.
notas_originais: , Ms. זְנָיוּ', Targ. Prov. XXIX, 3, read: זַנְיָיתָא, זְנָיָי', v. next w.

Targ. Joel IV, 3 (ed. Wil. וַנְיָתָא). Targ. Prov. VII, 10. Ib. VI, 26; a. e.—Pesik. R. s. 21 ברא דז' the son of the whore (heretic).— Pl. זַנְיָתָא, זַנְיָי', זְנָיָי'. Targ. Hos. IV, 14. Targ. Prov. XXIX, 3, v. preced. Y. Taan. I, 64 b bot. מיגר ז' hiring out prostitutes.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (seção r. de זָנָה) ser infiel, suspeito de infidelidade.; pensar em falta de fé.
definicoes_originais: (sec. r. of זָנָה) to be faithless, suspected of faithlessness.
notas_originais: —Part. pass. זָנוּן, pl. זְנוּנִים of spurious paternity. Pes. 87 a bot. ותוליד לך בנים ז' and she will bear thee spurious sons; ib. b ובניך ז'; v. זְנוּנִים.
Sot. 10 a, v. זָנָה.

verbetes.glosa_atual: , Pi.; esguichar, cuspir, ejetar com força.; [dar água na boca de uma pessoa,] deixar uma pessoa doente, negando-lhe um prato desejado.; deixar cair, derramar.
definicoes_originais: to squirt, sputter, eject with force.
[ to make a persons’ mouth water,] to make a person sick by withholding from him a desired dish.
notas_originais: זִינֵּק (b. h.)

Nidd. 59 b במְזַנֶּקֶת it means a woman discharging urin in a gush. Ḥull. 38 a זִינְּקָה the animal’s blood sputtered (when its jugular arteries were cut). Y. Yoma I, 39 a bot. חוטמו מְזַנֵּק תולעים his nose discharging worms.
Ex. R. s. 16, end אתם זִינַּקְתֶּם את בני וכ' ye made my children sick by withholding from them meat, when ye ate &c.
Y. Sabb. VIII, 11 b bot. במַזְנִיק שנו the Mishnah means when one uses pitch or sulphur in a liquid state.
, v. זוּעַ a. זעזע.
, Targ. Prov. XII, 21 some ed., v. עאתא.
, v. זְעֵיר, זְעֵירָא, a. next w.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (זְעַר) = h. נְעוּרִים, juventude, dias de juventude.
notas_originais: Targ. I Sam. XII, 2 (ed. Wil. זְעֵר־). Targ. II Sam. XIX, 8 זְעוּרָךְ (sing.); a. e.
Targ. Y. Gen. XXVII, 33.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (Pilp. de זוּעַ) mover, agitar, agitar, incomodar.; ficar abalado, assustado.; levantar-se em rebelião.; fazer tremer.
definicoes_originais: (Pilp. of זוּעַ) to move, shake, agitate, trouble.
notas_originais: Ex. R. s. 15, end ז' את הימים וכ' He stirred the seas up and showed to him (Moses) &c. Y. Ber. IX, 13 c bot. אני מְזַעֲזֵעַ עולמי I will make my world quake. Orl. I, 3 זִיעֲזַעְתּוֹ המחרישה the ploughshare loosened it (the roots of the tree); זִיעֲזָעוֹ ועשאו בעפר he (the husbandman) lifted the tree and placed it in soft earth (v. comment.).

Shebu. 39 a. Y. Ber. IV, 7 b נִזְדַּעְזְעָה החומה the wall was removed from its place; B. Kam. 82 b נז' א"י Palestine quaked. Cant. R. to III, 7 מתיראין ומִזְדַּעְזְעִין וכ' were frightened and shaken; a. fr.

Yalk. Num. 763 שנזדעזעו בני המדינה against whom the inhabitants of the country rebelled; a. fr.—Contracted part. מִזְדַּנְזִין, or מִזְדַּנְדְּזִין (= מזדעזעין). Ḥull. 48 a התלמידים מזדנז' בדבר ed. (Ar. מזדנדז') the students oppose it.
Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII, 8 אתה הִזְדַּעְזַעְתָּ … אֶזְדַּעְזֵעַ וכ' thou hast made thy limbs tremble …, so will I make my world quake, v. supra.
Targ. Ps. LX, 4; a. fr.
Targ. Y. Gen. XXVII, 33; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (redupl. de זעט, v. זוּטָּא) jovem, jovem, estudante.
definicoes_originais: (redupl. of זעט, v. זוּטָּא) young man, youth, student.
notas_originais: — Pl. זַעֲטוּטִים, constr. זַעֲטוּטֵי (a Variant of נערי, Ex. XXIV, 5, because נערי admits of the meaning of servants, slaves, Greek παιδές). Sifré Deut. 356 (v. מָעוֹן a. הִיא) and one manuscript existed in the Temple which was named ספר זעטוטים the Book of Zaʿăṭûṭim (containing זעטוטי for נערי); Treat. Sof’rim VI, 4 זאטוטי; Y. Taan. IV, 68 a bot. זעטוטי.—Meg. 9 a (reported as one of the changes in the Greek translation of the Pentateuch, and ref. to נערי l. c., and to אצילי Ex. XXIV, 1
זאטוטי ed. (Ms. Par. זע', oth. mss. a. Yalk. Gen. 3 זטוטי) ‘the youths’ (νεανίσκοι, in place of παιδές, v. LXX Ex. l. c.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: Targ. Y. Ex. XXIV, 11 Lev. (ed. עולימיא). Targ. Não pode. VI, 5.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Ex. XXIV, 11 Lev. (ed. עולימיא). Targ. Cant. VI, 5.

definicoes_originais: (v. זְעֵיר I) to be small, diminished.
notas_originais: Targ. Prov. X, 27 נזעין Ms. a. Var. ed. Lag. (ed. Lag. a. oth. זער).
, v. זֵיעָא
Targ. Prov. VII, 6 Lev. a. Buxt. (ed. Lag. זעירתא, Var. זעיי').
, v. זְעַק

verbetes.glosa_atual: , fut.; ser esguio, pequeno; ser reduzido, diminuído.; (cmp. צער) ficar doente.; para restringir.
definicoes_originais: to be slender, small; to be reduced, diminished.
notas_originais: יִזְעַר, נִזְעַר (cmp. זוּעַ; b. h. זְעֵיר)
Targ. Prov. X, 27, v. זְעִי. Targ. Jer. XXIX, 6; a. fr.—Y. Sabb. VIII, 11 a bot. זַעֲרַת ולא ז' וכ' it (the measure) was reduced, but was not made as small as it had been before; v. Ithpe.
Gen. R. s. 33 ותִזְעַר נפשיה and he may get sick.
Targ. II Sam. XVIII, 16 ed. Lag. a. Ar. (ed. מנע; h. text חשך).
Targ. Ex. XVI, 17; 18 (h. text הִמְעִיט). Targ. Lev. XXV, 16; a. fr.—Targ. Y. Num. XXII, 6 לאַזְעוֹרֵיה to reduce (defeat) him (h. text נכה).
Targ. O. Ex. XII, 4; a. e.
Targ. Y. Gen. I, 16.—Y. Shek. III, 47 c top [read:] אִזְּעִירָא ולא אִזְּעָרַת וכ' it was reduced, but not made as small &c., v. supra.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (precedido.) pequeno, jovem, tenro; menor; um pouco.
definicoes_originais: (preced.) small, young, tender; lesser; a little.
notas_originais: Targ. Gen. I, 16. Targ. O. ib. XLIV, 25.—Targ. Gen. XIX, 31; a. fr.—Y. Ber. II, 4 b ז' לא … דרבה the inferior does not greet the superior; Y. Shek. II, 47 a top דז' (not ר' ז').—Y. Snh. III, 21 a bot. משום דזעיר מיניה in behalf of one his junior. Y. Keth. V, beg. 29 c ומר ז' and said something small (insignificant). Ib. והדא היא ז' is this something small?; a. fr.—זְעִירִין, זְעֵירַיָּא. Targ. Y. Ex. XII, 4. Targ. Ps. CXV, 13; a. fr.—Y. M. Kat. III, 82 d top והוא שאיל לז' and he asked the inferior (scholars)?—Fem. זְעֵירָן, זְעֵירָתָא. Targ. O. Gen. XXXII, 10.—Targ. Ps. CIV, 25 (Ms. זוטרתא).
Y. Ter. VIII, 46 b bot. ז' בר חיננא. Y. Ber. V, end, 8 d ר' ז'; a. e.
, v. זְעֵיר II

verbetes.glosa_atual: Z’era, [também: זְעוּרָא, רָה…] nome de vários Amoraim.
definicoes_originais: Z’era, [also: זְעוּרָא, רָה …] name of several Amoraim.
notas_originais: Y. Ter. XI, 47 d bot.; a. fr. (in Bab. זֵירָא).—Y. Ber. VI, 10 d top; a. e.—Ib. I, 3 a top ר' ז' תנאי.—Ib. VIII, 12 c top; Gen. R. s. 3 ר' ז' בר אבהו.—Y. Sabb. I, 3 d ר' ז' בר אבינא. V. Fr. M’bo p. 77 b, sq.
Targ. Lev. XXV, 16; a. e.
, v. זְעֵיר II
— Part. pass. זָעוּם; f. זְעוּמָה; pl. זְעוּמוֹת. Num. R. s. 11 פנים ז' morose countenance, opp. מאירות; cmp. זָעַף.
Num. R. s. 11 פנים של ז', v. preced. Kidd. 66 a ויבדלו … בז' and Israel’s scholars parted under (the king’s) displeasure.
, v. זעזע, a. זוע.

—Part. act. זוֹעֵף; f. זוֹעֶפֶת, pl. זוֹעֲפוֹת, part. pass. זָעוּף; f. זְעוּפָה; pl. זְעוּפוֹת. Pesik. R. s. 21 פנים זוע' (a. זעו') serious (commanding) countenance. Pesik. Baḥod. p. 110 a; Yalk. Ex. 286 פנים זו', contrad. to בינוניות indifferent, מסבירות inviting, kind countenance.
Targ. Ps. L, 3 (h. text נשערה). Ib. X, 5 (h. text יפיח).—Gen. R. s. 63 בעא רבי דיִזְעוֹף ביה Rabbi wanted him (R. S.) to threaten him; Yalk. ib. 110 דיִזְעַף (Y. Ter. VIII, end, 46 c למינזף).

verbetes.glosa_atual: precedeu. wds.) vento tempestuoso, veemência; raiva.
notas_originais: Taan. III, 8 התחילו לירד בז' the rain began to come down with vehemence. Pesik. R. s. 15, v. אַגְרִיאוֹן. Treat. S’maḥ. III, 9 מיתה של ז' a sudden death (by the anger of the Lord); cmp. M. Kat. 28 a, s. v. דָּחַף.
Targ. Job I, 19 (ed. Wil. זַעְפָּא); a. e.—Ber. 59 a (expl. הרוחות Mish. ib. IX, 2).
Targ. Y. Lev. XV, 19 (ed. Amst. זְעָפָרָנָא).
Ex. R. s. 1 (ref. to Ex II, 23) אין וַיִזְעָקוּ אלא וכ' ‘they cried’ has the meaning of lamenting.
Gen. R. s. 67, v. זְעָקָה.
Targ. Ex. II, 23; a. e.
Yalk. Deut. 811; Yalk. Sam. 157 (as one of the expressions for prayer; Deut. R. s. 2 צְעָקָה). Gen. R. s. 67 ז' אחת וכ' Jacob caused Esau to utter one cry.
, Gen. R. s. 98, v. זְקִיפִין
, v. זְעֵיר II

verbetes.glosa_atual: =h. זֶפֶת arremesso.; = זִיפּוּת revestimento de piche.
notas_originais: . Targ. Is. XXXIV, 9. Targ. Ex. II, 3.
Y. M. Kat. II, 81 b top [read:] דזִיפְתָּהּ, v. דַּקְדְּקִירָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (Ζεφύριον) Z'firin, Zifirin etc., prob. o promontório de Chipre (v. Sm. Class. Dict. s. v. Zephyrium a. Neub. Géogr. p. 391), um lugar mencionado em conexão com as viagens de R. Akiba.
definicoes_originais: (Ζεφύριον) Z’firin, Zifirin &c., prob. the headland of Cyprus (v. Sm. Class. Dict. s. v. Zephyrium a. Neub. Géogr. p. 391), a place mentioned in connection with R. Akiba’s travels.
notas_originais: (v. Sm. Class. Dict. s. v. Zephyrium a. Neub. Géogr. p. 39

, a place mentioned in connection with R. Akiba’s travels. Y. B. Kam. IX, end, 7 a זופ'; Sifré Num. s. 4 זופרי', זפרונה; Num. R. s. 8 זיפ'; B. Kam. 113 a זפי' (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); Yalk. Num. 701 כופרי.

verbetes.glosa_atual: c. por favor. (Sir. זפלן, P. Sm. 1146; פלא, v. פְּלֵן, com pré-forma.
definicoes_originais: c. pl. (Syr. זפלן, P. Sm. 1146; פלא, v. פְּלֵן, with preform.
notas_originais: ז') a certain number, so and so many. Targ. II Esth. I, 8.

זִיפֵּף to line vessels with pitch.— Part. pass. Kal זָפוּף, Part. Pual מְזוּפָּף. Tosef. Ab. Zar. IV (V), 10 זְפוּפוֹת; Ab. Zar. 33 a מְזוּפָּפִין. B. Mets. 40 b במז' when the oil vessels are lined. V. זָפַת.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (זפק, cmp. ספק, שׂפק; cmp. אִיסְפְּקָא) colheita de pássaros.
definicoes_originais: (זפק, cmp. ספק, שׂפק; cmp. אִיסְפְּקָא) bird’s crop.
notas_originais: Ḥull. III, 4. Ib. 6 (one of the signs of clean birds). Lam. R. to IV, 15 ז' של תרנגולת, v. שַׁלְפּוּחִית.

Gen. R. s. 48 אתם … ומזקינים חביריכם you consider each himself young, and each his partner old (Yalk. ib. 82 ומז' אדניכם and believe your Lord too old [to do wonders]); v. supra.

Kidd. 32 b אין ז' אלא חכם under zaken (Lev. XIX, 32) a scholar is meant; Sifra K’dosh. Par. 3, ch. VII אין ז̇ק̇ן̇ אלא ז̇ה שק̇נ̇ה חכמה a zaken is he who has acquired wisdom (through study).—ז' אשמאי, v. אַשְׁמַאי. Yoma 28 b ז' ויושב בישיבה a scholar and member of college. Y. M Kat. III, beg. 81 c איני מכירך ז' I shall not recognize thee as (give thee the diploma of) a zaken; a. fr.— Pl. זְקֵנִים. Snh. I, 3, v. סְמִיכָה. Num. R. s. 14 מצות הז' rabbinical law. Ber. 11 a זִקְנֵי ב"ש the graduates of the Shammai school; a. v. fr.

Ex. R. s. 1 מעשה זְקֵנָן the conduct of their ancestor (Abraham). Pesik. Zakh., p. 27 b; a. fr.—Fem. זְקֵנָה, זְקֵינָה. 1) old woman. Gen. R. s. 39.—Nidd. 9 a ז' one who is past the change of life. Ib b; a. fr.—2) grandmother, ancestress. Kidd. 31 b הוה ליה ההיא אמא זקי' had a grandmother. Gen. R. s. 93 זְקֵינָתוֹ של זה this man’s (my) ancestress (Sarah); a. e.—3) (sub. נְטִיעָה) old plantation. Tosef. Shebi. I, 2; a. e., opp. נטיעה young plantation.— Pl. זְקֵינוֹת. Y. ib. I, 33 b bot.; a. e.

Ber. 11 a זְקָנְךָ וכ' thy beard is &c., v. גָּדַל. Snh. VIII, 1 (68 b) עד שיקיף ז' התחתון וכ' until he grows a beard, by which is meant the hair of the genitals &c.; a. fr.— Pl. זְקָנִים. Lev. R. s. 3.

to be converted into a loan.

Zar. 46 a ז' לבינה וכ' if one put a brick up to worship it, v. זְקִיפָה; a. fr.—Part. pass. זָקוּף, f. זְקוּפָה. M. Kat. III, 7 מטה ז' a put-up couch, opp. מ' כפויה an upset couch whereon mourners are seated; a. fr.

B. Mets. 72 a וזְקָפָן עליו במלוה and the creditor settles the interests on the debtor as a loan (the note stating the combined amount of principle and interest as principle). Gitt. 18 a עד שתפגום ותִזְקוֹף until she accepts partial payment (of her widowhood) and settles the balance as a loan (by taking a note &c.). Ib. זָקְפָה ולא פגמה if she allows her widowhood to be entered as a loan without taking a partial payment. Ib. אונס … שזְקָפָן במלוה indemnity for outrage, fines … which were settled in the way of a loan; a. e.

B. Mets. 59 b לא נפלו … ולא זָקְפוּ the bent walls did not fall, nor did they assume their straight position. Ber. 11 a וז' ר' ישמ' R. Y. remained upright, opp. הִטָּה. Ib. כשאני … אתה זָקַפְתָּ when I bowed, thou didst remain upright. Y. ib. IV, beg. 7 a זוֹקֵף he erects himself (from his bowed position).—Part. pass. זָקוּף, f. זְקוּפָה upright, erect. Ber. l. c.—קומה זקופה erect stature, proud carriage. Ib. 43 b; a. fr.
. Tosef. ib. I, 6; Sifré Deut. 34; a. e.
Gitt. l. c. מאימתי נִזְקָפִים במלוה from what time are fines &c. considered as converted loans (so as to be subject to limitation)?

to join, meet; to be engaged in.
to live with; to be coupled.

notas_originais: — Part. pass. זָקוּק, f. זְקוּקָה; pl. זְקוּקִים, זְקוּקִין, f. זְקוּקוֹת, with ל chained to, connected with, dependent on. Men. 27 a העושין פירות יהיו ז' וכ' the fruit-bearing species of the festive wreath shall be combined with those which bear no fruits. Y. Ber. VI, 10 a bot. כשהיו כולן ז' וכ' when they were, all of them, dependent on one loaf (for saying grace). Pesik. R. s. 43 כנגד שלש … זקוקות להן (not זקוקין) corresponding to the three laws for which, our Rabbis taught, women are made responsible (Sabb. II, 6). Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41 a top ז' למלכות in constant intercourse with the government.—Num. R. s. 9 לשנים היא זקוקה she is responsible to two (her husband and the Lord).—Shebu. VI, 3. נכסים … זוֹקְקִין וכ' movable chattel binds the immovable with reference to the obligation of making oath, i.e. the two claims preferred in one suit are considered as one lawsuit, and the oath must refer to both; Y. Keth. XII, 36 a bot. [read:] לזוֹקְקָן לשבועה to combine the two (as one lawsuit) with regard to the oath. Yeb. II, 5 זוֹקֵק את וכ' he holds his brother’s wife tied to the leviratical marriage, i.e. she cannot marry otherwise until released from him; a. fr. V. זִיקָה.

Gen. R. s. 20 מעולם לא נ' וכ' the Lord never engaged in communication with woman. Ib. s. 42; Pesik. R. s. 5; a. e. נ' המלך וכ' the king was attached to, took an interest in the affairs of the country. Sabb. 12 b אין מ"ה נִזְקָקִין לו the angels do not attend to his prayers.—[
Gen. R. l. c. באו ברברים לִיוָּקֵק לו (Pesik. R. l. c.; Ruth R. introd., a. e. להִזְדַּוֵּוג) Barbarians came to attack him.]

Ruth R. to IV, 3 ע"מ שלא אֶזָּקֵק לה with the condition that I will not live with her. Gen. R. s. 20 איני נִזְקֶקֶת וכ' I shall never again live with &c.—Pesik. R. s. 15; Pesik. Haḥod., p. 43 b שיהא אדם נִזְקָק לביתו in order that man be attached to his house (love his wife); Yalk. Ps. 738; a. e.
Succ. 28 a הִזְקַקְתּוּנִי וכ' will you force me to say &c.?

B. Bath. 170 a אם הוּזְקָקוּ וכ' Ms. M. (ed. אם כתוב בו הוּזְקַקְנוּ) if they (the parties to the deed) bound themselves to depend on the signatures of witnesses, &c. (ed. if it was written in the document, we obligate ourselves &c.).
Tanḥ. Korah 6 לא נִזְדַּקְּקוּ להשיבו (Yalk. Num. 750 נִזְקָקוּ) they did not care to answer him.

R. s. 14 התורה … ומז' וכ' the Torah is clarified and distilled in forty nine ways.—2) to chain, tie, connect.—Part. pass. as ab. Y. Ḥag. —Part. pass. מְזוּקַּק (Hebraism). Targ. Cant. I, 11.

notas_originais: Zeb. II, 1. Ib. 14 a; Yoma 49 a; a. fr.—Fem. זָרָה. Yeb. 85 b ותהא ז' וכ' granted that she is not of a priestly family;—is not a lay-woman permitted &c.?

Y. Ned. IX, beg. 41 b (ref. to אל זר, Ps. LXXXI, 10) זר שבקרבך וכ' do not make the enemy within thyself thy king; Sabb. 105 b איזהו אל זר וכ' which is the tyrannical power within thee?—Ex. R. s. 34 (play on זֵר a. זָר, v. זֵיר) if one is worthy נעשים לו זֵר ואם לאו זר they are to him a crown, if not—an enemy; Tanḥ. Vayakh. 8.—Fem. זָרָה. Yoma 72 b נעשית לו ז' Ms. O. (Ms. M. נעשית ז' ממנו) the Law appears to him a tyrant (Ms. M. she becomes estranged from him, v. זוּר).
Num. R. s. 7 (play on זָרָא, Num. XI, 20) והיאך נעשה ז' וכ' and how does he become an outcast? Leprosy overcomes him.— Pl. זָרִים. Ib. ז' מן הקהל excluded from the congregation.—Zeb. III, 1; a. fr.
Targ. Ps. XLIV, 19, v. זְהַהּ.—Sabb. 82 b, v. נְכַר.

verbetes.glosa_atual: v. precedido. um. próximo w.) náusea, aversão.
definicoes_originais: v. preced. a. next w.) nausea, loathing.
notas_originais: Num. R. s. 7; Lev. R. s. 18, v. דּוּרָא III, דְּרַרְיָא, זָרָנָא.

Kil. IX, 7 מנעול של ז' Ms. M. a. oth. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note; ed. זרד) a cloth-lined shoe; Y. ib. 32 d top.

verbetes.glosa_atual: cercar, alinhar, aparar.; (denominação de precedente) ser feito fluir sobre a borda, ficar chateado.
definicoes_originais: (denom. of preced.) to be made to flow over the rim, to be upset.
notas_originais: Y. Kil. IX, 32 d top (ref. to מנעול של זרב, v. preced.) אית אתרין דזַרְבִּין עימרא וכ' (not עימיה) there are places where they put wool around the shoe from inside.

Yoma 78 a משום דמִזְדְּרִיב ed. (Ar. משום דאתי לאִזְדַּרְבּוּיֵי, Ms. O. דילמא אתי לא', v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 70) because the silver vessel (being smooth) may be upset and liquid flow over. V. זִרְזֵיף.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. זָרָב) uma bandeja ou pires preso ao fundo de um recipiente para beber para receber pingos; em geração. pires, prato, disco.
definicoes_originais: (v. זָרָב) a tray or saucer fastened to the bottom of a drinking vessel for the reception of drippings; in gen. saucer, dish, disk.
notas_originais: Pesik. R. s. 35 שנדמה כז' קטנה וכ' (ed. Fr. זרבוכ', corr. acc.) whose face appeared (over the camp) like a small disk of fire; Yalk. Dan. 1062 כביבית (corr. acc., or כגִיגִית).— Pl. זַרְבּוּבִיֹּות. Lev. R. s. 5; Num. R. s. 10 (expl. מזרקי, Am. VI, 6) כוסות שיש להם ז' cups with saucers; Yalk. Am. 545 שאין בהם זכוכית (corr. acc.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: (v. זרג a. denom. P. Sm. 1154) zargão, nome de uma planta, prob. uma espécie de beterraba.
definicoes_originais: (v. זרג a. denom. P. Sm. 1154) zargon, name of a plant, prob. a species of beet.
notas_originais: Y. Kil. I, 27 a bot. ז' ולפת z. crossed with carrot. [It is evident that our w. cannot mean a vine-shoot, as Fl. to Levy Talm. Dict. I, 564, a. Löw Pfl. p. 87 suggest.—R. S. to Kil. I, 4 reads וגדין or זגדין.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: zargunah, nome de uma árvore ou arbusto com galhos abundantes, mas nus por baixo.
definicoes_originais: zargunah, name of a tree or shrub with copious twigs, but bare beneath.
notas_originais: Y. Succ. III, beg. 53 c
